name: Cyberjaya 21K 2026
short_description: Cyberjaya 21K 2026 is a 21.1 km half-marathon in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia, held on August 2, 2026, with registration now closed.
ai_summary: Cyberjaya 21K 2026 is a half-marathon organized by Tetrad Event Empire, scheduled for August 2, 2026, in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia. The race covers a primary distance of 21.1 km and starts at Rekascape, Persiaran APEC. Entry was priced at MYR 60, but registration is currently closed.
pros: Single clear half-marathon distance of 21.1 km
Organized by an established event organizer, Tetrad Event Empire
Convenient venue at Rekascape, Persiaran APEC, Cyberjaya
cons: Registration status is listed as Closed, so new sign-ups are not currently possible
research_highlights: The race takes place on Sunday, 2 August 2026 at RekaScape, Persiaran APEC, Cyberjaya, Selangor, with three distance options: 5km, 10km and 21km
Start time is listed as 4:00 AM, which is typical for tropical Malaysian road races to avoid daytime heat
Tetrad Event Empire is listed as the organizer/technical provider, with online registration handled via HeyJom
Online registration for this edition closed on 28 June 2026, so late/on-site sign-up does not appear to be an option

Cyberjaya hosts several similarly named running events in the same year (e.g. Cybercity Half Marathon, Cyberjaya Women Half Marathon), so participants should double-check they have the correct event and organizer when researching
